Create a premium 6x9 devotional cover scene along a luminous first-century Judean shoreline path by the Sea of Galilee. In the entire lower half, show TWO COMPLETE WALKERS' TRAILS side by side. Each walker's trail alternates clear left-right impressions from simple ancient leather sandals. Exactly at the halfway point, one whole trail stops suddenly; it does not blend into the other trail. From that transition onward, ONE COMPLETE WALKER'S alternating left-right sandal trail continues toward the horizon. Far ahead and faint in the bright atmosphere, a dignified first-century Jewish man in a cream tunic and mantle carries another fully clothed adult man safely in both arms. Use historically plausible flat leather sole impressions with restrained strap marks, no bare toes and no modern tread. 'One pair' means one walker's ongoing left-right trail, not two isolated prints. The image embodies divine companionship, endurance, and the revelation that Christ carried the traveler through the hardest ground. Bright cream-gold sand, pale blue water, fresh olive green, warm dawn, premium cinematic photographic realism, calm upper sky for typography. No halo, no crucifixion imagery, no text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
